about: The executable leaves of features/farrowing/scenario-tree.md (each leaf names its tree row in `tree`). Format: docs/design-workflow/scenarios.md. Run: node scripts/run-scenarios.mjs farrowing

tree.label: Home or Choose unit → room → search/filter → sow

children.label: Home, Farrowing section, whole-farm overview
tap the Farrowing tile
Home's Farrowing card lands on the room list, not the Task overview

gwt.given: A worker is on Home, in the Farrowing section, looking at the whole-farm overview.
gwt.when: They tap the Farrowing task card.
gwt.then: The room list opens on top, with its Awaiting, Active, Done and All tabs in front. The Task overview is not shown over it.

tree.label: Awaiting → counting → death draft → Back / resume / Clear / Save

children.label: Sow 000455, Awaiting (nothing recorded)
tap + on Born alive, then Save
The first saved birth makes her Farrowing; nothing else to press

gwt.given: Sow 000455 is open on her Awaiting face, with nothing recorded.
gwt.when: The worker taps + once on Born alive and taps Save.
gwt.then: She is now Farrowing and the count shows 1 alive and 1 born. There is nothing else to press to start.

authority.says: Farrowing starts at the first recorded event — full stop.
A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

record.says: alive 1, born 1

children.label: tap + then − on Born alive (nothing saved)
A + taken back before Save leaves her Awaiting, nothing recorded

gwt.given: Sow 000455 is Awaiting, with nothing recorded.
gwt.when: The worker taps + on Born alive, then −, and saves nothing.
gwt.then: Nothing was recorded: she reads Awaiting with born zero and an empty log.

authority.says: registers derive from the live total (posted + open pending)
A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

record.says: born 0, nothing posted, no draft

children.label: Report death, Born dead, + Stillborn, Done, Save
A stillborn can be the first record; she becomes Farrowing

gwt.given: Sow 000455 is Awaiting, with nothing recorded.
gwt.when: The worker reports one stillborn (Report death, Born dead) and saves the visit.
gwt.then: She becomes Farrowing. One stillborn is posted and born is 1.

authority.says: Record dead live (a stillborn can be the first record)

record.says: 1 stillborn posted, born 1

children.label: Sow 000418, Farrowing: alive 9, dead 1·1·2·0·0·1, nothing entered

gwt.when: The worker looks at the counting sheet.
gwt.then: The Alive card shows 9 and, at its right, when the record was last saved (Saved Aug 26 08:20).

authority.says: Saved · +4 this visit
A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

authority.says: A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

gwt.given: Sow 000418 is Farrowing with 9 alive and 5 dead, nothing entered this visit.
gwt.when: The worker taps + on Born alive, then −.
gwt.then: Born alive is back at 0 and its − is greyed. Alive is still 9 and born 14: nothing saved can be lowered from here.

authority.says: A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

visible.says: − greys at 0

record.says: alive 9, born 14, no draft

children.why: the prototype has no idle timer; the visit folds only on close
children.label: After ~90 min idle the visit folds into one log line

gwt.given: Sow 000418 is Farrowing and has an open visit with piglets added in it.
gwt.when: About 90 minutes pass with no one touching the sow.
gwt.then: The visit folds into one log line.

authority.says: The visit (pending window) ends … after ~90 min idle measured from the last interaction

children.label: Report death, + Crushed once
Done
Done takes the death to the visit, not saved; posted deaths unchanged

gwt.given: Sow 000418 is Farrowing and Report death is open with 1 crushed piglet added.
gwt.when: The worker taps Done.
gwt.then: The record is shown again with the death in the visit: Alive reads 8 and Not saved yet, with a −1 died chip. Posted deaths are unchanged.

authority.says: A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

visible.says: the card says the visit is not saved

record.says: the visit still holds 1 crushed
posted deaths unchanged

children.label: reopen Record dead
Reopening Report death finds the count

gwt.given: The worker left the Record dead drawer with Back while 1 crushed piglet was unsaved.
gwt.when: They open Record dead again.
gwt.then: Crushed reads 1 and its − is live. Posted deaths are unchanged.

authority.says: reopen and it is still there, green
No green for drafts: an unsaved draft is muted ink, never the recorded green.

visible.says: the drafted crushed can be taken back

record.says: posted deaths unchanged

children.label: + Crushed again (resume)
Resuming adds to the kept draft (2 unsaved), nothing posted

gwt.given: The worker reopened Record dead and the kept draft holds 1 crushed piglet.
gwt.when: They add one more crushed piglet.
gwt.then: Crushed reads 2. Nothing is posted, and posted crushed deaths stay at 2.

authority.says: tallies and the cause are a DRAFT until Save

record.says: draft 2, posted crushed still 2

children.label: Clear
Clear discards the draft; posted deaths unchanged; Clear disappears

gwt.given: The worker reopened Record dead and the kept draft holds 1 crushed piglet.
gwt.when: They tap Clear.
gwt.then: The counts are gone and Clear disappears with them. Posted deaths are unchanged.

authority.says: Clear discards the draft (a text action on the title row, present only while a draft exists)

visible.says: Clear gone with the draft

children.label: Done, then Save
Save posts the visit as one event; the crushed piglet comes off Alive

gwt.given: The worker reopened Record dead and the kept draft holds 1 crushed piglet.
gwt.when: They tap Save.
gwt.then: The visit is posted as one stamped event: crushed deaths go from 2 to 3 and Alive from 9 to 8. The draft is empty and the newest log line is the crushed death with its time and who.

authority.says: A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

record.says: crushed 3 posted, alive 8, draft empty
newest log line is the crushed death, stamped

children.label: A draft never crosses the lock: with the draft waiting nothing locks

gwt.given: Sow 000418 is Farrowing and a death draft is waiting on the device.
gwt.when: The worker looks at the bar after Done.
gwt.then: Nothing locks. The sow is not finished and the draft is still there.

authority.says: A draft never crosses the lock
Finish waits while a death draft is open; there is no lock to hold.

record.says: the draft is still there

children.label: With a visit open the bar offers Save, not Finish farrowing

gwt.given: Sow 000418 is Farrowing and a death draft of 1 is waiting on the device.
gwt.when: The worker looks at the bar after Done.
gwt.then: The bar is Back · Save: Finish farrowing is not offered until the visit is saved or cleared, so nothing can lock with a draft.

authority.says: Lock born N waits in the floor-gray family with the pointer 1 death unsaved · Record dead
A death draft still blocks Finish, shown as the design system now draws it: Finish disabled, its tap leads to Record dead (1 unsaved). No banner, no reason line.
A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not; Report death is a level with Back · Done

visible.says: no Finish while the visit waits
Save is the primary

record.says: not locked, the draft still there

children.label: Save the visit, then Finish farrowing
Once the draft is saved, Finish is live and the lock can be held

gwt.given: A death draft blocked Finish, and the worker saved it in Record dead.
gwt.when: They open Finish farrowing.
gwt.then: The Finish sheet opens and its lock control is live, so the lock can be held.

authority.says: this is a guard on the lock, not a gate on recording

children.label: hold Finish farrowing
The hold locks Born (15, with the saved death) and opens the record

gwt.given: The worker saved the death draft and the Finish sheet is open with its lock live.
gwt.when: They hold Finish farrowing until it commits.
gwt.then: Born locks at 14, counting the saved death. The locked record opens and has no counting stepper.

authority.says: Born = Alive + Σ Dead … Derived, never entered, locks at Finish.
Lock born N is hold-to-commit

visible.says: no counting stepper after the lock

record.says: locked; frozen Born = alive + dead; crushed 3

children.label: dismiss the drawer after Done: tap (or swipe down on) its handle
Dismissing the drawer keeps the visit on the device

gwt.given: The Record dead drawer is open with 1 crushed piglet added but not saved.
gwt.when: The worker dismisses the drawer by its handle (the scrim does the same).
gwt.then: The drawer closes and the visit is kept: 1 crushed piglet is still not saved.

authority.says: Back or the dismiss gesture keeps it on the device
Drawers have no ✕: the footer Back is the exit; swiping down on the handle or tapping the scrim is Back.

children.label: the app is closed and reopened
A restart keeps the draft on the device

gwt.given: The worker left the Record dead drawer with 1 crushed piglet unsaved.
gwt.when: The app is closed and opened again on the same device.
gwt.then: The draft is still on the device with 1 crushed piglet.

authority.says: Back and the dismiss gesture … KEEP the draft on the device (persisted across background and restart)

children.why: the prototype is one in-memory device; no sync to test
children.label: Two phones saving deaths on one litter merge as signed deltas; a floor breach holds with a sync review line

gwt.given: Two phones have the same litter open and each is saving deaths.
gwt.when: Both phones sync.
gwt.then: The deaths merge as signed changes. If the result would breach the floor, it is held with a sync review line and is never silently applied.

authority.says: Merge contract (DRAFT): count events merge as signed deltas … never silently applied

children.label: Finish, nothing waiting
tap (no hold) Finish farrowing
A tap alone does not lock; the hold is the second guard

gwt.given: The Finish sheet is open for a sow, with nothing waiting.
gwt.when: The worker taps Finish farrowing without holding.
gwt.then: The sow does not lock. The hold is the second guard.

authority.says: the Finish sheet's hold-to-lock stays the second guard

children.label: tap Yes on Assisted
Assisted is a required No / Yes: No is chosen on a new finish, Yes moves the ring

gwt.given: The Finish sheet is open for a sow, with nothing touched.
gwt.when: The worker taps Yes on Assisted.
gwt.then: Assisted was No before the tap (no unanswered state, no Clear); now Yes is chosen and the record holds Yes.

authority.says: Assisted is required, No preselected; no Clear

children.label: type 12,6 in the Litter weight field
The litter weight is typed on the phone's decimal keyboard; a comma becomes a point

gwt.given: The Finish sheet is open for a sow, with nothing touched.
gwt.when: The worker taps the Litter weight field and types 12,6 on the phone's decimal keyboard (a comma locale).
gwt.then: The field reads 12.6 kg, the sheet stays open and Finish farrowing is still there. No Numpad opens.

authority.says: Litter weight stays optional, typed on the phone's own decimal keyboard (Done closes it)

children.label: hold Finish farrowing
The locked record: Born 14 frozen, Edit and Record dead, no Finish

gwt.given: The Finish sheet is open for a sow whose born count is 14, with nothing waiting.
gwt.when: The worker holds Finish farrowing until it commits.
gwt.then: The locked record opens with born frozen at 14. Edit and Record dead are offered and Finish is gone.

authority.says: Bar Edit · Record dead.
locks at Finish

children.label: Counting, Litter details, Edit record open
Crushed − once
A changed row shows its new value in ink with a muted "was N"; no banner

gwt.given: Sow 000418 is Farrowing and Edit is open, with 2 crushed deaths.
gwt.when: The worker lowers Crushed by one.
gwt.then: The changed row shows its new value in normal ink with a small muted note of what it was (was 2). There is no banner and no Corrected tag. Save correction is live.

authority.says: A changed row shows its new value in normal ink with a small muted "was 2" beside the label; no banner, no Corrected tag; one Save correction in the footer.

visible.says: the row says what it was
no banner
no Corrected tag
Save correction is live

children.label: Save correction
Save writes one stamped correction; Born heals from its inputs

gwt.given: Edit is open on Sow 000418 and Crushed has been lowered from 2 to 1.
gwt.when: The worker taps Save correction.
gwt.then: One stamped correction is posted and Counting is shown. Crushed is 1 and born heals to 13.

authority.says: Save commits everything as one stamped correction event
Born has no door pre-lock (it heals when its inputs heal)

record.says: crushed 1, correction event, born 13

children.label: Clear
Clear discards the correction draft

gwt.given: Edit is open on Sow 000418 and Crushed has been lowered from 2 to 1.
gwt.when: The worker taps Clear.
gwt.then: The correction draft is discarded. No change is waiting and crushed is still 2.

authority.says: Clear (text action on the summary row) discards it

children.label: Back with the change unsaved
Back with unsaved changes asks "Save correction?" and stays on Edit until answered

gwt.given: Edit is open on Sow 000418 with one change not yet saved.
gwt.when: The worker taps Back.
gwt.then: A Save correction? question opens with Save and Discard both available. Edit stays open until it is answered, the change is still waiting, and posted crushed deaths are still 2.

authority.says: Leaving Edit with unsaved changes asks "Save correction?" (Save / Discard) in the shared dialog, so an unsaved correction can never reach Finish.

visible.says: the ask is open

record.says: still on Edit, one change waiting, posted crushed still 2

children.label: Discard
Discard drops the change and returns; nothing is posted

gwt.given: The Save correction? question is open over Edit, with one unsaved change.
gwt.when: The worker taps Discard.
gwt.then: Litter details is shown again. The change is dropped, nothing is posted, and the log still has the same four lines.

authority.says: Discard in the Save correction? ask drops the unsaved change.

record.says: no draft left, posted crushed still 2
nothing posted (the four log lines it had)

children.label: Save
Save in the ask posts one stamped correction and returns

gwt.given: The Save correction? question is open over Edit, with one unsaved change lowering Crushed from 2 to 1.
gwt.when: The worker taps Save.
gwt.then: One stamped correction is posted and Counting is shown. Crushed is 1, and the newest log line is the correction saying Crushed 2 to 1.

authority.says: Save in the Save correction? ask commits the correction (who, old → new in the log) and returns.

record.says: crushed 1, one correction line (Crushed 2 → 1)

children.label: Locked record (born 14), Edit open
Correct born ✎, More born 1 (alive), Apply, Save correction
Anyone corrects Born after the lock: 14 → 15, stamped, original kept in the log

gwt.given: A sow's record is locked with born 14 and Edit is open.
gwt.when: The worker opens the born correction, adds 1 more born, applies it and saves the correction.
gwt.then: Born is now 15, recorded as a stamped correction. The original finish line is kept in the log. No role is needed to do this.

authority.says: Anyone may amend born post-lock — open ✎, stamped, no role gate.

record.says: born 15, a correction event
the original finish line is kept

children.label: View log

authority.says: One ledger surface, the Farrowing record page
corrections amber with ✎
